summary:
Stack exhaustion on input with a large number of '{'. The advisory lists
the affected range as 2.5.0 - 2.5.1 (fixed in 2.5.2) and calls it an
incomplete fix for CVE-2023-1370: 2.5.0 made the depth limit conditional
(`limitJsonDepth`, set by the LIMIT_JSON_DEPTH option, added in commit
da2e833), and parsers built with custom options left it off. That
conditional code does not exist in 2.4.11: JSONParserBase.readArray and
readObject apply the MAX_DEPTH = 400 check unconditionally in every
parser mode. trivy flags 2.4.11 anyway, but GitHub's advisory range
starts at 2.5.0.
